twitterHandle.description: Twitter/X handle for updates and announcements

linkedInUrl.description: LinkedIn profile or company page URL

coverImageUrl.description: URL to the collection's cover/banner image. Proportion 5:1. Possible variants include cover1500, cover370, cover320. Usage example: /<image-url>/cover1500

iconUrl.description: URL to the collection's icon/logo image. Proportion 1:1. Possible variants include icon160, icon128, icon96, icon80, icon64, icon56, icon48, icon40, icon32, icon24, icon20, icon12. Usage example: /<image-url>/icon160

darkTheme.description: Whether the collection uses a dark theme in the UI

primaryColor.description: Primary brand color for the collection (hex format, e.g., '#6366f1')

vaults.description: Array of all vaults included in this collection

address.description: Address of the vault contract

valueAsset.description: Address of the asset used for vault valuation and accounting

symbol.description: Token symbol for the vault shares (e.g., 'ADYV')

organisationId.description: Identifier of the organisation that manages this vault

tagline.description: Short marketing tagline for the vault

description.description: Detailed description of the vault's investment strategy and objectives

iconUrl.description: URL to the collection's icon/logo image. Proportion 1:1. Possible variants include icon160, icon128, icon96, icon80, icon64, icon56, icon48, icon40, icon32, icon24, icon20, icon12. Usage example: /<image-url>/icon160

defaultAssetManagementWallet.description: Default asset management wallet address for moving assets from the vault

chain.description: Blockchain network information where the vault is deployed

id.description: Internal identifier for the blockchain network

name.description: Human-readable name of the blockchain network (e.g., 'Ethereum', 'Polygon')

chainId.description: Numeric chain identifier as defined by EIP-155 (e.g., 1 for Ethereum mainnet)

financials.description: Latest financial metrics and performance data for the vault

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp when this financial snapshot was recorded

chainId.description: Blockchain network identifier (e.g., 1 for Ethereum mainnet)

vaultAddress.description: Address of the vault contract

totalSupply.description: Total number of vault shares in circulation (in wei)

netShareValue.description: Net asset value per share (in wei, denominated in valueAsset)

shareValueUpdatedTimestamp.description: Unix timestamp when the share value was last updated

sharePrice.description: Current price per share (in wei, denominated in valueAsset)

blockNumber.description: Block number when this financial data was recorded

netAssetValue.description: Net asset value after deducting all liabilities (in wei)

organisation.description: Organisation that manages this vault collection

identityProviderOrganisationId.description: Organisation identifier from the external identity provider system
